import os
from hamana import OracleConfig, OracleConnector

# Build standalone configuration object
config = OracleConfig(
    user="scott",
    password=os.getenv("ORACLE_PASSWORD"),
    host="localhost",
    service_name="ORCL"

result = connector.execute("SELECT sysdate FROM dual")
